title: The Distant Blue Hour
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Cyrus Vane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
